notes: Company background: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Customer-facing chat + in-app assistant to help users setup reports and interpret anomalies.
Current provider: using a mix of OpenAI and vendor-X managed endpoints. Primary ask: migrate to Redwood Hosted first, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.
Decision criteria: prompt parity (exact behavior for customer-facing assistant), latency <200ms for 95pct of user messages, predictable monthly spend, and auditability for support transcripts.

POC scope (agreed w/ AE/SE): 2-week Hosted smoke POC to validate API compatibility and prompt parity; 8-week Dedicated pilot to validate throughput and cost at 10k daily active users simulated workload.

Technical concerns raised on call: tokenization differences causing name/entity truncation in outputs; beam/temperature differences producing inconsistent reranking; embedding dimensional mismatch across providers causing search drift.

SE notes: will run a prompt-parity harness (150 canonical prompts) + automated regression detection (BLEU/ROUGE + human QA checks). Proposed compatibility layer: adopt Redwood's OpenAI-compatible endpoint mapping and small shim to adjust system-level prompts and stop-token behavior.

Cost discussion: target reduce per-1M-token cost by 30% when moving to Dedicated; need clear assumptions for batching and KV caching impacts. Asked Redwood for example bill-of-materials and committed capacity tiers.
Legal/Security: requires SOC2 Type II report, KMS integration (AWS KMS), and an audit log export cadence (30 days initially). Data residency: US-only preferred.
Quote from Head of Product: 'Prompt parity is non-negotiable — even small wording shifts confuse our end users.'

poc_details: Hosted smoke POC (2 weeks): validate OpenAI-compat endpoint mapping, run 150 canonical prompts, run automated regression detection + 20 human spot checks.
Dedicated pilot (8 weeks): simulate 10k DAU workload with 30 RPS sustained bursts, measure 95pct latency and cost/Bill-of-Materials. Include KV caching test for session retention across long chats.
Success criteria: <=5% functional regressions on canonical prompt set, median latency <120ms, cost reduction >=25% vs. current provider at target throughput.
migration_notes: Primary migration path: Hosted API for quick parity tests -> Dedicated for performance & cost.
Compatibility shim: small request/response adapter to normalize stop tokens and echo-behavior differences. SE recommends min diff to avoid user-visible changes.
Prompt engineering: will freeze system prompts during POC; track any distributional drift with regression harness and human evals.
Embeddings: run A/B quality test with current embeddings vs Redwood-quantized embeddings; expect vector drift — plan to reindex semantic search only after Dedicated pilot validated.
